items.text: The contract preserves the source-defined contributor path, architecture-basis handling, schema and unit invariants, deterministic checks, protected/private-data and licensing boundaries, documentation and review records, safe-versus-unsafe examples, visible unresolved onboarding decisions, and the distinction between contribution acceptance and professional engineering approval.
